label: Text 1
transcript: Mr. Yilmaz handed out a one-page short story called The Found Letter. "Read it twice," he said. "Once for the plot, once for the writing." The first read took eleven minutes. The second took twenty-three.

label: Text 2
transcript: By the time June found the letter, her grandmother had been dead for six years. The letter was sealed and unaddressed. It had been written, June was almost certain, in the days before her grandmother had stopped writing entirely. The handwriting was the same — except for one shaky line at the end, which June read three times before she put the letter back into the box. She did not open it that Tuesday. By the next Sunday, she had decided.
